ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white field across ~70% of visible surface area, contrasted against dense low-intensity black margins and internal mottling (~30%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white core regions on both lobes. Low-intensity black contiguous bands along the entire trailing edge and lobe tips. Irregular black punctate mottling distributed throughout the white field, with higher density on the left proximal lobe and right distal lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped indentation; approximate 115-degree divergence angle at the central vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-level serrations along the trailing edge. Distinct macro-indentation (large jagged peak) on the distal quarter of the right fluke's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to tapered, slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distributed clusters of small, circular low-intensity spots across the white field, notably concentrated in the lower medial region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant jagged indentation/irregularity on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe, indicating possible prior tissue loss.
